body:
From the Build tab, the human can ask for notes on a release. An agent then drafts them. Notes are never drafted on their own.

- The draft covers the tasks, features and decisions completed since the previous release (for the first release, everything completed before it).
- It groups changes by feature and links each entry to its task.
- The human sees the draft on the Build tab with that release.

Not in this task: editing, approving and storing the notes (the next task).

Done when: asking for notes on a release produces a draft grouped by feature, each entry linking its task, covering only the work completed since the previous release.
title: notes: draft release notes on request
